name: Walker X
summary: UBTECH's flagship large humanoid, shown as Walker in 2018 and updated as Walker X in 2021. Aimed at home and reception service, it demonstrates force-controlled balance, stair climbing, standing on one leg while being pushed, carrying trays and playing chess. It seeded UBTECH's later industrial Walker S line.
notable: Among the first large Chinese service humanoids
Force-controlled push recovery and stair climbing demos
